mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in prior month fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >50% of instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6.0 fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 during late-cycle supply shocks signals manufacturing output constraints that reduce corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained residential construction (HOUST) above 1000 thousand units signals housing market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.
